description: List every host seen for a domain (or IP address) across its newest scans, grouped by evidence: observed (the browser requested it) and scripts (a script the browser loaded) by default; declared (named in Content-Security-Policy, intent only), static (a URL in script source) and referenced (only a string or comment) on request in sources. subdomains_only keeps hosts below the domain. max_scans (1 to 1000, default 200) is how many scans to aggregate; limit (1 to 10000, default 500) caps hosts per source.
name: get_domain_hosts
title: Get Domain Hosts
